title: Answer: voluntary choice is the adjustment of precision in novel contexts

statements.text: Agency begins with the goal-directed work any self-organizing system does. Voluntary behavior is the capacity to adjust the precision weighting of competing needs, which gives a mechanistic account of choice in unpredicted contexts. Libet's findings do not show that free will is an illusion.

sources.quote: This capacity provides a formal (mechanistic) account of voluntary behavior—of choice.
if the organism is going to make plausible choices in novel contexts (cf. "free will") it must do so via some type of here-and-now assessment
